name: gittree
description: A fast, open-source Git desktop client for visual history and local-first repository management.

scripts.start: npm run build:compile && node scripts/prepare-build-assets.js --renderer-only && electron .
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run audit:design
scripts.quality:full: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:baseline && npm run test && npm run test:coverage && npm run audit:design && npm run test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts: node --test test/license-configuration.test.js test/release-configuration.test.js test/i18n-parity.test.js test/hardening.test.js test/html-encoder.test.js test/dialog-service.test.js test/ipc-handler-registry.test.js test/git-ipc-handlers.test.js test/hosting-ipc-handlers.test.js test/repository-ipc-handlers.test.js test/window-application-ipc-handlers.test.js test/application-runtime.test.js test/diagnostics-exporter.test.js test/settings-diagnostics.test.js test/preload-contract.test.js test/ipc-parity.test.js
scripts.test:performance: npm run perf:renderer && npm run perf:workspace
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:collect && npm run test:coverage:scopes
scripts.build: npm run build:compile && npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build:compile && npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:compile && npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:compile && npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:compile && npm run prepare:assets && electron-builder --linux --publish never
